cands.name: Eric Gray
cands.bio: Democrat, 50. Executive Director/President of the Christian Service Center for Central Florida; Orange County Planning & Zoning Commission member; former East Orlando Chamber chair. Named Orlando Sentinel Central Floridian of the Year (2024).
cands.local_ties: Lives in East Orange County with his family; seventh-generation Floridian; UF graduate (campaign site).

record.text: Previously ran for Orange County Commission; entered this race in Oct 2025.

money_notes.text: Has raised about $143,000 through his campaign and committee, including $14,000 from the Florida Project (progressive candidates), $1,000 each from the committees of U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost and Sen. Carlos Guillermo Smith, and $1,000 from Stan Van Gundy.

endorsements.text: Orlando Sentinel editorial board, Rep. Anna Eskamani, Equality Florida Action PAC and UNITE HERE locals representing Disney workers; also Vote Common Good.

cands.name: Erika Booth
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 48. About 20 years as an elementary teacher; Osceola County School Board 2022-2023. Lost the Jan 2024 special election to Tom Keen, then won the seat back in Nov 2024. Married to Osceola County Commissioner Ricky Booth.
cands.local_ties: Born in Kissimmee in 1977; lives in St. Cloud (Wikipedia).

record.text: Says three of her bills were signed into law in her first session; her HB 1399 insurance bill passed the House and died in a Senate committee.
Osceola County School Board District 5, Nov 2022 to Dec 2023 (resigned).

money_notes.text: Has raised more than $675,000 through her campaign and Booth PAC. In Oct 2026 she received $10,000 from Universal and $35,700 from a school-choice political committee; other contributors include the Seminole Tribe, insurance companies, Disney and Florida Realtors.

endorsements.text: Fraternal Order of Police, Florida Chamber of Commerce and the Central Florida Hotel and Lodging Association PAC; also, per the ClickOrlando guide, the PBA, Florida Professional Firefighters and Osceola Sheriff Chris Blackmon.

cands.gaps: Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.
